notes: I discovered the multi-word rule: each word after the first has the letters of the first word removed (e.g. "world" minus {h,e,l,o} = "wrd", "moon" minus {s,u,n} = "moo"→"mo"), then the last word gets 'h' unless it ends in o/y. This explains E3's "sun moh", "hello " (empty), and E1's "helo wrd"/"two rds".
